gameEverywhere.s1Sentence: Par {{worst}}s are where your round goes - you play them to +{{worstAvg}} a hole while your par {{best}}s run at +{{bestAvg}}. They're {{share}}% of every card you play, so it's the biggest single lever you have.
gameEverywhere.s1Sub: Your average score over par, by hole type
gameEverywhere.s2SentenceEarly: You start slowly: holes {{best}} are {{spread}} shots better than holes 1-6. Hit a few balls and roll some putts before you tee off - your opening holes are doing your warm-up for you.
gameEverywhere.s2SentenceEven: You score evenly across the round, wherever you play - no weak stretch. To go lower, warm up properly before the first tee and keep eating and drinking every few holes so it stays that way.
gameEverywhere.s2SentenceLate: You fade late: the closing six cost {{spread}} shots more than holes {{best}}. Take on water and something to eat around the 12th, before the drop-off starts.
gameEverywhere.s2SentenceMiddle: Your middle six cost {{spread}} shots more than holes {{best}}. That's usually where focus drifts - pick a target on every shot through the turn.
gameEverywhere.s2Sub: Shots dropped in each third, everywhere you play
gameEverywhere.title: Your game, everywhere
